dataset_name: Grounded Real Estate Agent Golden Set
design_notes: Built from verified city and category statistics before question generation.
No internal record identifiers appear in questions or expected answers.
Payment and buyer-requirement terms are generated policy assumptions.
No currency is assigned because the CSV has no currency field.
